critique: The delivered results establish the three separated asymptotic branches and feasible branchwise inference, but they do not provide one data-driven procedure valid near either transition, so the advertised software use requires an externally supplied regime classification. Feasible nuisance replacement and calibration are proved only for the one-dimensional smooth-boundary Bernoulli subclass, while the broader marked regular-variation class receives oracle results only. The efficiency theorem concerns regularity along a constructed ambient dominated experiment whose paths are not shown to remain in the model class, so it is not a class-intrinsic or minimax efficiency frontier. The final Honest scope is stale and internally contradictory because it labels Theorem 3 and several proved ingredients unestablished despite the preceding theorem and proof text. The absence of an implemented application or numerical calibration study, together with non-specific sourcing of the classical leaf lemmas, limits the completed package's leading-journal score.
